text: did you know that having high
cholesterol can increase your risk of
having a heart attack or stroke
cholesterol is a waxy fat like substance
that is important for metabolism and is
used by your body to make hormones
however too much of it can lead to
serious health issues such as heart
disease ldl cholesterol or bad
cholesterol can stick to the walls of
your arteries and cause blockages
preventing blood from getting to the
heart and increasing your chances of a
heart attack or stroke
[Music]
hdl cholesterol or good cholesterol
carries ldl cholesterol away from the
arteries and back to the liver to be
broken down and passed as waste
known as the silent killer high
cholesterol generally does not have
obvious symptoms which is why it is
extremely important that you visit your
doctor regularly for checkups even if
you are feeling well and healthy
while there is no single cause for high
cholesterol there are risk factors that
can contribute to the condition these
include age smoking lack of physical
activity obesity or being overweight
family history and an unhealthy diet
most of these risk factors for heart
disease can be managed by making
lifestyle changes such as improving your
diet exercising more and quitting
smoking your doctor may also recommend
certain medications to help lower and
manage your cholesterol levels if you
are 45 or older or from 30 for
aboriginal or torres strait islander
peoples see your doctor for a
cholesterol test as part of a heart
health check and if you have a family
history of premature heart disease or
high cholesterol you should speak to
your doctor about your heart health
earlier
